description: Canonical checklist for R6 → OpenCenter Handover Readiness. Every check in this file is evaluated before the bundle is released to OpenCenter deployment.

checks.title: Local toolchain
checks.description: Verify required generation and validation tools are present and executable.
checks.expectedOutput: Tool version inventory
checks.remediation: Install missing binaries: python3, git, kubectl, kustomize.

checks.title: PyYAML and Kustomize available
checks.description: Verify Python yaml module and kustomize CLI are callable.
checks.expectedOutput: yaml.safe_load works; kustomize version returned
checks.remediation: pip install pyyaml; install kustomize binary.

checks.title: Git repository accessible
checks.description: Verify git status and recent commit are readable.
checks.expectedOutput: git rev-parse HEAD returns a SHA
checks.remediation: Ensure the project is a git repository and HEAD is valid.

checks.title: Registry access
checks.description: Verify the container registry is reachable (HTTP 200/401 on ping).
checks.expectedOutput: HTTP response from registry API
checks.remediation: Check registry credentials and network connectivity.

checks.title: Kubernetes cluster access
checks.description: Verify kubectl can contact the target cluster.
checks.expectedOutput: kubectl cluster-info returns server URL
checks.remediation: Set KUBECONFIG or configure ~/.kube/config for target cluster.

checks.title: GitOps repository access
checks.description: Verify the GitOps repo directory exists and git status is clean enough to import.
checks.expectedOutput: GitOps directory exists; git status exits 0
checks.remediation: Clone the GitOps repository or fix the opencenter cluster directory.

checks.title: Storage capability discovery
checks.description: List available StorageClasses in the target cluster.
checks.expectedOutput: List of StorageClass names
checks.remediation: Verify cluster has required StorageClasses provisioned.

checks.title: Prometheus Operator capability
checks.description: Check if Prometheus Operator CRDs are installed in the cluster.
checks.expectedOutput: servicemonitors.monitoring.coreos.com CRD found or absent
checks.remediation: Install prometheus-operator or kube-prometheus-stack via Flux.

checks.title: Velero capability
checks.description: Check if Velero CRDs are installed in the cluster.
checks.expectedOutput: schedules.velero.io CRD found or absent
checks.remediation: Install Velero operator via Flux.

checks.title: Baseline regression fixtures
checks.description: Run the full R6 test suite (67 tests) to prove backend generation is correct.
checks.expectedOutput: 67 passed, 0 failed
checks.remediation: Fix failing tests before proceeding to handover.

checks.title: Bundle directory exists
checks.description: Verify the bundle_dir was provided and the directory exists on disk.
checks.expectedOutput: bundle_dir is a directory with expected subdirectories
checks.remediation: Generate the bundle first via POST /api/r6/generate-bundle.

checks.title: business-system.yaml present
checks.description: Verify the OpenCenter BusinessApplicationSystem blueprint is generated.
checks.expectedOutput: business-system.yaml parses as valid YAML with kind=BusinessApplicationSystem
checks.remediation: Re-generate the bundle.

checks.title: bundle-validation.json present
checks.description: Verify the Stage 12 gate result file exists and has zero blockers.
checks.expectedOutput: bundle-validation.json with status PASSED or PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS
checks.remediation: Fix all bundle blockers and re-generate.

checks.title: image-manifest.json present
checks.description: Verify the image manifest lists all component images.
checks.expectedOutput: image-manifest.json is valid JSON with images array
checks.remediation: Re-generate the bundle.

checks.title: Rollback runbook present
checks.description: Verify operations/rollback-runbook.yaml exists with all required sections.
checks.expectedOutput: rollback-runbook.yaml with gitRevision, images, traffic, dataLimitations
checks.remediation: Re-generate the bundle (rollback runbook is generated unconditionally).

checks.title: Zero plaintext secrets in bundle
checks.description: Scan all generated YAML for credential patterns.
checks.expectedOutput: No password/token/secret patterns found in generated YAML
checks.remediation: Remove any hardcoded credentials. Use SecretContract references.

checks.title: Generation is deterministic
checks.description: Generate the bundle twice with identical input and compare output structure.
checks.expectedOutput: Identical file list and normalized YAML on second generation
checks.remediation: Investigate non-deterministic fields (timestamps, random IDs).

checks.title: All components have a generated image tag
checks.description: Verify image-manifest.json covers every deployable component.
checks.expectedOutput: image count equals deployable component count
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle — every CONTAINERIZED component must produce an image.

checks.title: Validation Job images are digest-pinned
checks.description: Check that validation-jobs.yaml references images with @sha256: digest.
checks.expectedOutput: All Job images use @sha256: reference format
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle — validation Job images must be digest-pinned.

checks.title: Namespace has PSS labels
checks.description: Verify namespace.yaml carries enforce/audit/warn=restricted labels.
checks.expectedOutput: pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted present
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle — PSS labels are added unconditionally.

checks.title: Security contexts are non-root
checks.description: Verify Deployment/StatefulSet pod specs have runAsNonRoot=true.
checks.expectedOutput: runAsNonRoot: true in podSecurityContext
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle — security context is hardened by default.

checks.title: HPA generated when autoscaling configured
checks.description: Verify HPA is present for all components with hpa field set.
checks.expectedOutput: HorizontalPodAutoscaler present for each hpa-configured component
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle with correct hpa configuration.

checks.title: PDB generated for multi-replica workloads
checks.description: Verify PodDisruptionBudget is present for replicas>=2 Deployment/StatefulSet.
checks.expectedOutput: PodDisruptionBudget present for multi-replica components
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle — PDB is generated automatically for replicas>=2.

checks.title: Operator CRs generated for OPERATOR_MANAGED components
checks.description: Verify PostgreSQL/Redis/RabbitMQ/Kafka CRs are in the bundle.
checks.expectedOutput: operator-cr.yaml files present for all OPERATOR_MANAGED components
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle — operator CRs are generated automatically for OPERATOR_MANAGED.

checks.title: ServiceMonitor generated when Prometheus Operator available
checks.description: Verify observability.yaml with ServiceMonitor exists when platform supports it.
checks.expectedOutput: ServiceMonitor present in observability.yaml
checks.remediation: Install prometheus-operator or kube-prometheus-stack and re-generate.

checks.title: Velero Schedule generated for stateful namespaces
checks.description: Verify velero-schedule.yaml exists when the namespace has PVCs.
checks.expectedOutput: velero-schedule.yaml with correct namespace and schedule
checks.remediation: Install Velero and re-generate bundle.

checks.title: PVC StorageClass correctly set
checks.description: Verify PVCs with explicit storageClass field carry the correct storageClassName.
checks.expectedOutput: storageClassName set on all PVCs that require a specific class
checks.remediation: Set storageClass on the component and re-generate.

checks.title: Default-deny NetworkPolicies present
checks.description: Verify default-deny ingress and egress NetworkPolicies exist in the bundle.
checks.expectedOutput: NetworkPolicy with podSelector: {} for ingress and egress
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle — NetworkPolicies are generated unconditionally.

checks.title: Gateway and Certificate have renewBefore
checks.description: Verify Certificate resource has renewBefore: 720h when a Gateway is configured.
checks.expectedOutput: Certificate.spec.renewBefore == 720h
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle — renewBefore is set unconditionally on certificates.

checks.title: Kustomize staging overlay renders
checks.description: Run kubectl kustomize on the staging overlay and verify it produces valid YAML.
checks.expectedOutput: kubectl kustomize overlays/staging exits 0
checks.remediation: Fix kustomization.yaml or referenced resource files.

checks.title: Kustomize production overlay renders
checks.description: Run kubectl kustomize on the production overlay and verify it produces valid YAML.
checks.expectedOutput: kubectl kustomize overlays/production exits 0
checks.remediation: Fix kustomization.yaml or referenced resource files.

checks.title: YAML parse — all generated documents
checks.description: Parse every .yaml file in kustomize_bundle/ with yaml.safe_load_all.
checks.expectedOutput: All YAML files parse without error
checks.remediation: Fix malformed YAML in generated files.

checks.title: Flux Kustomization file exists
checks.description: Verify flux/<slug>-kustomization.yaml was generated with prune: true.
checks.expectedOutput: Flux Kustomization with prune: true and correct path
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle.

checks.title: Kubernetes server-side dry-run
checks.description: Apply generated resources with --dry-run=server to validate against live cluster CRDs.
checks.expectedOutput: kubectl apply --dry-run=server exits 0 for all generated resources
checks.remediation: Fix schema violations identified in dry-run output.

checks.title: VM bindings documented for unresolved components
checks.description: Verify all KEEP_ON_VM_FOR_NOW components with no IP have VMServiceBinding resources.
checks.expectedOutput: VMServiceBinding present for every unresolved VM component
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle — VM bindings are created automatically.

checks.title: No fabricated IPs for unresolved VMs
checks.description: Verify EndpointSlices are only generated for VMs with a real target IP.
checks.expectedOutput: EndpointSlice present only for VMs with non-empty targetIp
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle — endpoint creation is gated on real IP.

checks.title: Stage 12 gate: zero blockers
checks.description: Confirm bundle-validation.json reports status PASSED or PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS.
checks.expectedOutput: bundle_validation.status != BLOCKED
checks.remediation: Fix all items in bundle_validation.blockers and re-generate.

checks.title: Secret scan: no plaintext credentials
checks.description: Scan generated files for credential patterns (password=, token=, secret=).
checks.expectedOutput: Zero credential pattern hits in generated YAML
checks.remediation: Remove all inline credentials. Use SecretContract or external secret references.

checks.title: Validation Jobs generated
checks.description: Verify validation-jobs.yaml exists with HTTP, DNS, and/or database Jobs.
checks.expectedOutput: validation-jobs.yaml with at least one Job document
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle — validation Jobs require at least one HTTP component.

checks.title: Stage 13 execution endpoint exists
checks.description: Verify POST /api/r6/run-validation responds to a health probe.
checks.expectedOutput: Endpoint returns 400 on empty body (not 404)
checks.remediation: Ensure the dashboard is running with Stage 13 endpoint registered.

checks.title: Rollback runbook completeness
checks.description: Verify all required sections exist in the rollback runbook.
checks.expectedOutput: gitRevision, images, traffic, vmWorkloads, dataLimitations, verificationSteps all present
checks.remediation: Re-generate bundle (rollback runbook is generated unconditionally).
